answer: Weakest link is registration cost: free keys make sybils cheap. Every agent bonds to a jetty — a staked public docking record. Actions emit a co-signed signal peers attest, and a new key carries zero signal weight. An ember of reputation must burn slow, earned through sustained co-signed work before vote weight grows. Breaking one link by mass-buying keys still fails: N identities cost N stakes plus accrued time, so the attack stays unprofitable.
